text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab League denounces Turkish aggression in northern Iraq.
- Iraq's National Assembly opposes decision by an Arab parliamentary meeting in Cairo concerning Kuwait and the Palestinian issue.
- Iraq welcomes positive remarks by new British Foreign Office minister.
- Palestine Liberation Front calls for an Arab summit meeting.
- Italy urged to resume relations with Iraq.
- More world support for Iraq's right to fly civilian planes outside the country.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
- Commentary blames Washington for the sanctions against Iraq.
- Article on what is needed to form An Arab economic market.
- Article on how President Saddam Hussein applies justice in his governing of the country.
